function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value

function.name: OLEPictureImpl_Construct
function.description: This function constructs an OLEPictureImpl object. It initializes the object, sets up the virtual function table, and handles the allocation of memory for the object. If the pictDesc parameter is provided, it sets the description of the new object and handles different picture types.

parameters.name: pictDesc
parameters.description: Pointer to a picture descriptor. If provided, it is used to set the description of the new object and handle different picture types.

parameters.name: fOwn
parameters.description: Boolean flag used to set the ownership of the new object.

parameters.name: pict
parameters.description: Double pointer to an OLEPictureImpl object. The new object is assigned to this pointer.

function.name: OLEPictureImpl_Destroy
function.description: This function is used to destroy an OLEPictureImpl object. It releases the connection point if it exists, deletes the picture if the object owns it, and finally frees the memory allocated for the object's data and the object itself.

parameters.name: Obj

function.return_type: void, which means this function does not return any value.

function.name: OLEPictureImpl_QueryInterface

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPicture interface.

parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL.

function.name: OLEPictureImpl_LoadWICSource

parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICImagingFactory object used to create WIC components.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If it failed, it returns an error code.

It checks the validity of the icon data, selects the best icon if multiple are available, and creates the icon from the resource. It also sets the picture type, icon handle, original width and height, and himetric width and height in the OLEPictureImpl object.

parameters.description: Pointer to the OLEPictureImpl object where the icon will be loaded.
